pages.text:
RYAN CHRISTIAN G. LADESMA
salupod.
Project Title: Proposed Community Library
Location: Brgy. Santor, Malolos Bulacan
Software: Autocad / Revit / D5
SALUPOD is derived from the Filipino
words Salubong, meaning a meeting or
coming together, and Pusod, meaning the
center or core. Together, these words
express the idea of a community library as a
central place where people, knowledge,
and nature converge. The concept focuses
on creating a welcoming environment that
encourages learning, reflection, and
meaningful social interaction. A landscaped
central atrium serves as the heart of the
building, connecting different spaces and
establishing a sense of unity throughout the
design. Through interconnected spaces,
natural elements, and a balance between
quiet and communal areas, SALUPOD
promotes an atmosphere where individuals
can pursue knowledge while remaining
connected to others. Ultimately, the
concept envisions the library as more than a
place for books and research; it becomes a
shared community space that nurtures
learning, strengthens relationships, and
fosters a lasting sense of belonging.
Keywords:
1.Wisdom 6.Core
2.Connection 7.Inclusivity
3.Gathering 8.Convergence
4.Beacon 9.Exchange
5.Orbit

concept_text: SALUPOD is derived from the Filipino words Salubong, meaning a meeting or coming together, and Pusod, meaning the center or core. Together, these words express the idea of a community library as a central place where people, knowledge, and nature converge. The concept focuses on creating a welcoming environment that encourages learning, reflection, and meaningful social interaction. A landscaped central atrium serves as the heart of the building, connecting different spaces and establishing a sense of unity throughout the design. Through interconnected spaces, natural elements, and a balance between quiet and communal areas, SALUPOD promotes an atmosphere where individuals can pursue knowledge while remaining connected to others. Ultimately, the concept envisions the library as more than a place for books and research; it becomes a shared community space that nurtures learning, strengthens relationships, and fosters a lasting sense of belonging.
perspective_text: The facade features a woven geometric pattern inspired by traditional Filipino weaving. Its interlocking diamond shapes symbolize the connection between people, knowledge, and community, reflecting SALUPOD's concept of gathering and convergence. The perforated design also filters natural light, reduces direct sunlight, and creates a dynamic play of light and shadow.

name: Lakbay
title: Lakbay: The Journey of Learning

pages.text:
02
HIGH SCHOOL DEV.
16

images.method: embedded original, complete frame; WebP derivatives without upscaling

pages.text:
RYAN CHRISTIAN G. LADESMA
lakbay.
Project Title: Proposed Highschool Dev.
Location: Brgy. Santor, Malolos Bulacan
Software: Autocad / Revit / D5
Lakbay represents the journey of every
student—from the first step into the school,
through the continuous process of learning,
interaction, and discovery, toward personal
growth and graduation. The school is
envisioned not merely as a place for
academic instruction, but as a dynamic
environment where every space contributes
to the students’ educational experience.
Through interconnected learning areas,
flowing circulation, communal spaces, and
opportunities for interaction with nature,
the design encourages students to explore,
collaborate, and develop their potential.
The curved architectural form symbolizes
the continuity of this journey, guiding
students through different spaces and
experiences while expressing movement,
connection, and progression. By integrating
functional planning, climate-responsive
strategies, and welcoming outdoor spaces,
LAKBAY transforms the school into a
meaningful journey where the environment
supports not only academic achievement
but also social development, creativity, and
personal growth.
Keywords:
1.Movement 6.Encounter
2.Sequence 7.Connection
3.Direction 8.Weaving
4.Rhythm 9.Growth
5.Pause 10.Discovery

pages.text:
RYAN CHRISTIAN G. LADESMA
dalawit.
Project Title: Proposed Duplex
Location: Brgy. Santor, Malolos Bulacan
Software: Autocad / Revit / D5
DALAWIT: Duality — Interlocked
Sanctuaries is an architectural concept
inspired by the principles of duality,
interlock, and sanctuary, representing two
individual homes connected through a
unified architectural composition. The
concept explores the balance between
togetherness and individuality, allowing
two households to coexist harmoniously
while maintaining their own identity,
privacy, and comfort. Through duality, the
design expresses two distinct residential
units within a shared architectural form,
while interlock translates their connection
into the arrangement of building masses
and spaces. Sanctuary emphasizes the
creation of a safe, peaceful, and private
environment where each family can
experience comfort and belonging.
Ultimately, DALAWIT envisions a
harmonious duplex where two homes are
interconnected yet remain distinct,
balancing architectural unity with personal
independence and providing each
household with its own private sanctuary.
Keywords:
1.Kinship 6.Interlock
2.Balance 7.Unity
3.Gathering 8.Roots
4.Duality 9.Sanctuary
5.Harmony 10.Connection

concept_text: DALAWIT: Duality — Interlocked Sanctuaries is an architectural concept inspired by the principles of duality, interlock, and sanctuary, representing two individual homes connected through a unified architectural composition. The concept explores the balance between togetherness and individuality, allowing two households to coexist harmoniously while maintaining their own identity, privacy, and comfort. Through duality, the design expresses two distinct residential units within a shared architectural form, while interlock translates their connection into the arrangement of building masses and spaces. Sanctuary emphasizes the creation of a safe, peaceful, and private environment where each family can experience comfort and belonging. Ultimately, DALAWIT envisions a harmonious duplex where two homes are interconnected yet remain distinct, balancing architectural unity with personal independence and providing each household with its own private sanctuary.
perspective_text: The feature wall combines organic patterns with modern interior design strategies, creating a visually striking focal point that adds elegance, texture, and character to the living space. The decorative panels feature intricate leaf-inspired forms that introduce natural elements into the interior, while their metallic finish adds sophistication and visual depth. The use of vertical arrangements emphasizes the room's height and creates a sense of continuity. Complementing the feature wall, the neutral color palette, minimalist furniture, warm accent lighting, and large windows establish a balanced and contemporary atmosphere. This combination of natural inspiration and modern detailing creates an interior that is both aesthetically refined and welcoming.
